name: unm-plugin-mikrotik-swos
description: UnifiedNetworkManager plugin for MikroTik SwOS / SwOS Lite switches (CRS + CSS series): monitoring via the .b-file HTTP API with Digest auth, port/PoE/LAG/VLAN/SFP inventory propagation, and plan/config actions (port config, PoE, LAG, VLANs, SNMP, system identity/management access, backup download).
